text: We meet Mr. Abu Abdulrahman, who tells us about his experience with the Al-Tayyibat system. Please go ahead. By God, I had diabetes for about 30 years. In the end, the medications
made me very tired. I became dizzy and exhausted, with no strength or energy. I could not even sleep well or walk
to the mosque, even though it was only about 100 to 150 meters away. By God's grace, for about 45 days, maybe more—around 50 days—
I have been following the Al-Tayyibat system. By God's grace, I say that I no longer take insulin, blood-pressure medicine, or anything else.
The numbness went away, the fatigue went away, I started sleeping better, and I started eating sweets. I used to be deprived of sweets. To me, sweets are energy and life. [laughs]
Now, thank God, I feel my life has changed completely. Even yesterday at a condolence gathering, everyone who saw me was amazed. They said, 'Sheikh Mohammed, mashallah,' and I climbed the stairs
very easily. I see this as a blessing from God. I am committed to the system—not 100%—
maybe 80% to 90% committed to the Al-Tayyibat system, and despite that, I feel I am doing very well. My family is surprised by my health at this
stage, by God's grace. My wife was just saying that I have started going to the mosque quickly again.
I now go out and walk. I can walk three or four kilometers a day without getting tired or dizzy. The numbness is gone. My whole body used to feel numb, as if I had been given anesthesia, because of
all the medications I was taking. I used to take 13 pills a day along with three insulin doses. Now, thank God, I say that I no longer take
any kind of medication. I also used to suffer from bowel and colon problems and difficulty with bowel movements, and I never felt comfortable.
I was always tired and exhausted. Now, by God's grace, I feel all of that has improved. I began noticing improvement within the first seven to ten days. [clears throat]
Now, by God's grace, I feel very well and as if I were young again. I am about 61 years old, but I feel that my condition
is very good. May God reward the late Dr. Diaa Al-Awady for this idea and for the knowledge that I believe benefited many people.
Of course, for a long time I liked foods that I now consider problematic. I especially liked
white bread, but now I completely avoid it. I also avoid chicken and foods that I believe contain added hormones, and even some vegetables
that I believe are not naturally produced. I do not eat those at all. By God's grace, I do eat sweets, chocolate, and halva every day.
I feel that things are going well and that my health is now very good. Before, I could work for only
four or five hours before getting tired. Now I can work for very long hours—up to about 17 hours—without feeling the same exhaustion, by God's grace.
I see this as a blessing from God. May God reward you. Thank you. Thank you for your kind words.
